statements.text: Impression: right-sided lumbar radiculopathy secondary to L3-L4 disc herniation causing foraminal stenosis.

MRI lumbar spine 08/18/2026: L3-L4 disc herniation with moderate right foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.
Pain limits walking to about one block and has forced the patient to stop volunteering; sleep is disrupted most nights.
Reports low back pain radiating to the right leg for 6 weeks.

Continues the daily home exercise program taught in PT.
No red flags: afebrile, no unexplained weight loss, no history of malignancy, no saddle anesthesia.
Epidural steroid injection history: 2 lumbar injections in the past 12 months (05/20/2026, 07/02/2026).
